item.title: The Geely EX5 Refines Value In Its Segment
item.description: Being first is not always a good thing. Case in point—slipstream. The car following is using less energy to make the same speed as the car in front. Therefore, they are equipped with more power to do an overtake. In Geely’s situation, that overtake might happen with the new EX5 EM-i. Read More »
